use_case: Ticketing platform demand tools: price recommendations for general admission ticket tiers, and bot screening with an on-sale queue for high-demand on-sales
vendor_or_model: Ticketing platform vendor (machine-learning demand forecast and risk scoring in SYS-01)
data_categories: Pricing: sales pace, tickets remaining, days to show, page views, queue size, aggregate results for similar shows (no patron-level data, tested). Bot screening: device and browser signals, network address and type, request timing, account age; session records kept 30 days by the vendor
consequential_decision_category: None (same price for every buyer at a given time; access to one on-sale only); re-tier High if patron-level data is used to price or orders are cancelled automatically
human_in_the_loop: Every price change accepted or rejected by the Box Office and Ticketing Manager within floors and ceilings set before on-sale; accessible tiers excluded; Owner approves changes over 20% in 24 hours. Bot screening decisions are automated; people handle appeals, releases (logged), and any order cancellation
applicable_laws: 16 CFR Part 464 (464.2 total price; 464.3 fees) and FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(a), (n) (N71-R05); ADA Title III 28 CFR 36.302(f)(1)(ii), (f)(3), (f)(4), (f)(8); BOTS Act 15 U.S.C. 45c and Fla. Stat. 817.36(5) (protect the company); state personal-data pricing laws not applicable while no personal data is used
status: In production since 2026-04-06 (9 shows priced; 6 protected on-sales); approved with conditions 2026-08-31; conditions due 2026-09-15 to 2026-11-30

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by the Marketing Coordinator to draft show descriptions and social posts
human_in_the_loop: The Marketing Coordinator edits every draft; prices in drafts are checked for total price before posting (POL-02 A.8)
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(a) (claims in posts) and 16 CFR 464.2 (any price in a post must be the total price); no patron or card data allowed (POL-02 C.3; POL-04 4.7)
status: Allowed for Public information only; not assessed further
